tests_run.expected_failure: AssertionError: presentation masking must preserve the pending form value

coverage: Actual unmodified inline model and UI scripts execute together in a Node VM with DOM-boundary stubs; no UI/model functions are replaced.
DOM-boundary innerHTML replacement recreates settings controls from rendered defaults, reproducing the original browser failure.
Actual Settings navigation, change listeners, global mask onclick, and delegated privacy-mask click handlers are exercised.
Retention 7 and 90 drafts survive both mask controls in both directions.
Muted and snoozed notification drafts and existing-checkout workspace drafts survive the global mask control in both directions; the privacy-local control exists only in the Privacy group.
Pending form values and settingsDirty remain intact; clean settings remain clean.
Masking neither requests discard consent nor changes committed settings, retention, content capture, sessions, or launch state.
Declined navigation discard retains the draft and dirty guard after masking.
Explicit Apply while masked commits the retained draft; subsequent Cancel restores the last applied value.
Masking still updates labels, aria-pressed, rendered task/path metadata, trusted-project path, and project option labels without changing option values.
Existing offline/no-network/no-storage API checks, syntax compilation, and model regressions continue to pass.

result.root_cause: maskToggle called render, whose renderSettings rebuilt the form from committed values and reset settingsDirty. Presentation-only masking therefore implicitly discarded unapplied edits without consent.
result.fix: Only maskToggle changed in the study HTML. It snapshots every current settings select value and settingsDirty before the existing masking/render path, then restores both afterward. All editable settings currently use selects. Existing metadata masking and explicit Apply/Cancel behavior remain unchanged; no draft is applied or stored by masking.
result.tdd: Regression tests were added and all seven failed for the expected discarded-draft assertion before the HTML change. The bounded HTML patch then passed all seven regressions and the complete fifteen-test design suite without changing the regression assertions.
result.scope: Only the two assigned repository files were modified. No original assets, runtime cleanup files, repository/Git state, staging, pushes, actions, configuration, network calls, dependencies, or production implementation were changed. This report is the sole additional authored evidence file.
limitations: VM DOM-boundary tests verify inline interaction/state behavior, not browser layout, focus, accessibility-tree rendering, or production Qt behavior.
Real Chrome verification remains with the parent agent as requested.
Runtime cleanup and live harness/browser/desktop tests were not run; those are outside this task's ownership.
